facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports Bank of Ghana Governor Asiama saying the bank has extended PAPSS to mobile wallets in the Ghana-Nigeria corridor.

RWA.note: Only a licence passporting framework with Ghana; no Rwanda mandate fact stated.

facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports the Bank of Ghana saying it is piloting cross-border interoperability with CBDCs, stablecoins, bank accounts and mobile wallets in the Ghana-Rwanda and Ghana-Nigeria corridors, with the aim of moving to live services.
Ghana News Agency reports the Bank of Ghana saying it has extended PAPSS to mobile wallets in the Ghana-Nigeria corridor.
Ghana News Agency reports the Bank of Ghana saying it is piloting cross-border interoperability with CBDCs, stablecoins, bank accounts and mobile wallets in the Ghana-Rwanda corridor.

GHA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

RWA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
